IN THE GRENFELL TOWER INQUIRY
STATEMENT OF BEHAILU KEBEDE
1. My name is Behailu Kebede. I lived in Flat 16 on the fourth floor of Grenfell Tower. I
believe that the fire on 14“’ June 2017 started in my kitchen.
2. In this statement, I discuss various matters including my background, Grenfell Tower,
my flat, the night of the fire and my life since then.
Ethiopia
3, I was bom on 2"“ April 1973 in Addis Ababa, the capital of Ethiopia. My family are
Orthodox Christians.
4, My father was a lawyer. He passed away in 1997. My mother was a civil servant. She
is retired now and still lives in Addis Ababa. I was one of four siblings and the oldest
boy in the family.
5. We were a content middle class family who enjoyed a good quality of life and did not
want for anything. I received my high school diploma and aspired to become a pilot. I
have extremely fond memories of my childhood.
6.
Behailu Kebede 1
IWS00000490 0001Coming to the UK
7.
8.
9.
10. In 1991, both my younger brothers joined me in the UK. When they first arrived, we
all stayed together in a hostel. However, I then applied to Kensington and Chelsea
Council for accommodation. About 25 years ago, I was offered Flat 16 in Grenfell
Tower. I think this was in about 1992.
Living at Grenfell Tower
11. It is difficult to explain just how happy I was to move into Flat 16 in Grenfell Tower
with my younger brothers. I was so grateful that we were given accommodation. This
was our first real home in the UK. I have so many wonderful memories of the three of
us living there together. My brothers were still at school and I felt a sense of
responsibility to look after them.
Behailu Kebede 2
